name: Codex built-in Computer Use vs Computer Pilot
purpose: Compare general desktop work across perception, editing, recovery, and cross-app transfer without optimizing for one application.

cases.goal: In the supplied Finder workspace, create Ready, move only alpha.txt and archive.txt from Incoming into Ready, rename Ready/archive.txt to archive-approved.txt, and leave beta.txt and notes.txt in Incoming.
cases.oracle: Independently compare the exact owned directory tree and file bytes after the task.

cases.goal: In the supplied plain-text document, change only the current-release section, move the validation section, check one item, preserve repeated historical values, Unicode, punctuation, blank lines, and the final newline, then save.
cases.oracle: Compare the saved file byte-for-byte with the expected task-owned artifact.

cases.goal: Update only the primary section in a JSON file, only the current section in a Markdown file, and selected checklist items; preserve fallback/history sections and unrelated literals.
cases.oracle: Compare all task-owned files byte-for-byte and verify the workspace contains no extra edits.

cases.goal: Read the task-owned reminder and create a Calendar event with the exact title and requested time, without using unrelated reminders or events.
cases.oracle: Read both applications independently and compare the event title, time, and source reminder identity.
cases.side_effects: One uniquely named reminder and one uniquely named event, cleaned after each trial

cases.goal: Complete six order forms, apply two later corrections, and finish the archive while preserving every untouched field.
cases.oracle: Independent fixture verification checks every initial field, both corrections, and the final archive state.

cases.goal: Use an initially observed control, tolerate one UI transition that invalidates the observation, refresh the target, and complete the requested edit exactly once.
cases.oracle: Verify the edit happened once, the stale action was not replayed, and no unrelated control changed.
